handoffPurpose: Capture the hotfix for laggy pan and zoom interactions on large maps after the world-map launch.
currentUserGoal: Make large-map panning and zooming feel smooth on the live large-field view.

workCompleted.summary: Added a transformed common-layer preview for batch-mode pan and zoom. During interaction the existing render-texture snapshot is translated/scaled cheaply, then a precise redraw is requested after input settles.
Added cached composite common-tile textures so settled batch redraws stamp one texture per tile instead of stamping base, grass, and hazard pieces separately.

verificationPerformed.result: Passed after the pan/zoom preview and composite-tile changes.

verificationPerformed.commandOrCheck: Large viewport manual stress check at http://127.0.0.1:5173/?stress&perf&tiles=2500 with viewport 1720x1240
verificationPerformed.result: Before this hotfix, arrow-pan around 475 visible tiles measured about 68ms layout and zoom-out near 1989 visible tiles measured about 118ms layout. After the hotfix, pan preview measured about 2ms with a settled redraw around 15ms; zoom preview measured about 1.5ms with a settled redraw around 32ms.

knownIssuesOrDesignQuestions: The first large-field layout still pays a one-time composite-texture creation cost in the perf overlay. The interaction path is substantially smoother; a future pass could prewarm composites gradually after load.

During active pan/zoom, newly entering edge tiles may appear from the previous transformed snapshot until the settled redraw catches up. This trades perfect per-frame redraw accuracy for smooth interaction.
recommendedNextSteps: If the user still feels a hitch after releasing zoom, add background composite prewarming and/or async settled redraw.
Consider a stricter large-map minimum zoom now that the minimap provides whole-world context.
doNotRevert: Do not remove the common-layer transform preview without replacing it; synchronous batch restamping was the source of the pan/zoom hitch.
Keep unrelated local AGENTS/docs edits separate from this hotfix commit unless the user explicitly asks to include them.
